title: Designing and Exploration of the Biological Potentials of Novel Centrosymmetric Heteroleptic Copper(II) Carboxylates.
authors: Viola; Muhammad, Niaz; Noor, Awal; Sirajuddin, Muhammad; Kubicki, Maciej; Rahim, Shahnaz; Samad, Abdus; Shujah, Shaukat; Wadood, Abdul; Ali, Saqib
one_liner_zh: 该文研究新型铜(II)配合物的合成及其与DNA的结合能力，虽涉及小分子-DNA互作和分子对接，但对象为金属配合物而非蛋白质-DNA体系，方法仅常规对接，与TF-DNA课题关联较弱。
abstract: Copper(II) complexes with a general formula [Cu(2)(3,4-F(2)C(6)H(3)CH(2)COO)(4)(L)(2)], where L = 2-methylpyridine (1) and 3-methylpyridine (2), are reported here. The FTIR spectra of the complexes confirmed the bridging bidentate coordination mode of the carboxylate ligand. The low (475 and 449 cm(-1)) and strong (727 & 725 cm(-1)) intensity bands in the FTIR spectra, due to Cu-N stretches and pyridyl ring vibrations, confirmed coordination of the 2-/3-methyl pyridine co-ligands in complexes 1 and 2, respectively. A binuclear paddlewheel structural arrangement with a square pyramidal geometry was confirmed for copper atoms in the complexes via single-crystal X-ray analysis. The DPPH, (*)OH radical, and alpha-amylase enzyme inhibition assays showed higher activities for the complexes than for the free ligand acid. The binding constant (K(b) = 1.32 x 10(5) for 1 and 5.33 x 10(5) for 2) calculated via UV-VIS absorption measurements and docking scores (-6.59 for 1 and -7.43 for 2) calculated via molecular docking showed higher SS-DNA binding potential for 2 compared to 1. Viscosity measurement also reflected higher DNA binding ability for 2 than 1. Both complexes 1 and 2 (docking scores of -7.43 and -6.95, respectively) were found to be more active inhibitors than the free ligand acid (docking score of -5.5159) against the target alpha-amylase protein. This in silico study has shown that the herein reported compounds follow the rules of drug-likeness and exhibit good potential for bioavailability.
abstract_zh: 本文报道了通式为[Cu(2)(3,4-F(2)C(6)H(3)CH(2)COO)(4)(L)(2)]的铜(II)配合物，其中L = 2-甲基吡啶（1）和3-甲基吡啶（2）。配合物的FTIR光谱证实了羧酸配体的桥联双齿配位模式。FTIR光谱中低强度（475和449 cm(-1)）和强强度（727和725 cm(-1)）的谱带分别归因于Cu-N伸缩振动和吡啶环振动，确认了配合物1和2中2-/3-甲基吡啶共配体的配位。通过单晶X射线分析，确认了配合物中铜原子具有双核桨轮结构排列和方形金字塔几何构型。DPPH、(*)OH自由基和α-淀粉酶抑制实验显示，配合物的活性高于游离配体酸。通过UV-VIS吸收测量计算的结合常数（K(b) = 1.32 x 10(5)（1）和5.33 x 10(5)（2））以及通过分子对接计算的对接分数（-6.59（1）和-7.43（2））表明，2比1具有更高的SS-DNA结合潜力。粘度测量也反映2比1具有更高的DNA结合能力。配合物1和2（对接分数分别为-7.43和-6.95）对靶标α-淀粉酶蛋白的抑制活性均高于游离配体酸（对接分数为-5.5159）。这项in silico研究表明，本文报道的化合物符合药物相似性规则，并表现出良好的生物利用度潜力。
